analyst_view.overall: Real Oviedo (11th, 21 points) host Celta Fortuna (18th, 14 points) on Monday night to close the matchday, with Oviedo in crisis: Raúl González replaced Julián Calero and lost his first two games (0-3 at Córdoba, 1-2 against Girona), fan groups are protesting against the Grupo Pachuca owners and the 25 November shareholders' meeting was tense, though chairman Martín Peláez says the club fully backs the coach. Oviedo's long absence list (David Jiménez banned; Reina, Sáenz, Calvo and Chris Ramos injured) is counted by the numbers. Celta Fortuna have one point from their last two and no win in five, but drew 1-1 with Valladolid last time; the club's medical report lists Hugo Cuenca (training partly with the group) and Stefan Bajčetić (adductor, awaiting tests) on top of the brief's list, while Mateo Sobral, whom the brief lists, is not on it. No referee is named; the crisis cuts both ways (pressure to win, but low confidence), so I stay with the numbers.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.5 goals, 1.4 for Oviedo, already taking a lot off Oviedo for Reina, Sáenz, Jiménez and others (together about -26%) and adding for Calvo missing at the back. Oviedo's turmoil and the new coach's poor start are partly in their recent form; Bajčetić's possible absence (club report, awaiting tests) weakens Fortuna's midfield but is not confirmed, so I stay at 2.5.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.4 corners, 6.4 for Oviedo, raised 7% for their recent corners and because Fortuna have conceded 45 in six. Oviedo have won 83 corners this season to Fortuna's 54, and nothing in the news changes that pattern, so I stay at about 10.4.

cards.text: The numbers say 6.2 cards and already add a little for both sides' recent bookings. A tense, protesting crowd could add edge, but both clubs foul a lot all season (Oviedo 212 fouls, Fortuna 198), which the numbers know, and no referee is named, so I stay at 6.2.

shots.text: The numbers say 29.4 shots, 18.3 for Oviedo, already raised 10.5% for their recent shooting. Oviedo's long-range shooters such as Estanis fit that volume and Fortuna's young side has let opponents shoot a lot, all counted, so I stay at about 29.4.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.2 shots on target, already lifted 13% for Oviedo's 35 on target in six. Their top scorer Carlos Domínguez (5) is not reported missing and Fortuna's top scorer Álvaro Marín (8) is not on the club's medical report, so nothing points either way and I stay at 10.2.
